}}'''Elienda''' was a ''[[Far Dareis Mai]]''.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Elienda}}

== Appearance ==
She was tall with wide shoulders.

== Activities ==
She was part of [[Perrin Aybara]]'s army that goes into [[Ghealdan]]. She searched for traces of [[Faile Bashere]] when Faile was captured by the [[Shaido]].

With the help of [[Elyas Machera]], she finally found the Shaido camp in the town of [[Malden]]. She reported back to the [[Wise Ones]] on the layout of the camp.

She was killed while taking out the Shaido sentries around Malden.
